gold_review.explanation: _extract_json only reads completion[-1] if it is a dict; verifiers 0.3.1 passes completion messages as pydantic CustomBaseModel objects (legacy/types.py:77-88, subscriptable but not dict instances), so every reply (even a perfect JSON diagnosis) parses as None and trace_score returns 0. Secondarily the answer is the truth spec (uses "observations" not "evidence"), so even a fixed grader would need a reformatted reply.
